answer: The ledge I would price into every new account is Escapement maker dial standard stamped by the timekeepers guild: each dial is a calibration record countersigned by the assay office, so a farm must cut a hundred real escapements by hand, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the grove for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The ember is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
